messages:
sara_sales: hey team — POC with Acme broken. They get 401 "invalid_api_key" hitting /v1/generate. We sent them the key via email. Any known gotchas for auth?

alex_se: do we know if they created a project under their org? keys are project-scoped now so org/project mismatch often causes 401/403. can you paste the exact curl they used?

sara_sales: sure — this is what they sent:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_ABC123" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{"model":"gpt-large","input":"hi"}'
```

micah_support: quick checklist: 1) token prefix should be ri-sk- for hosted keys, 2) token must belong to the project they are calling, 3) check scopes (inference). if the key was regenerated recently it might be disabled.

jordan_eng: adding: we rolled out project-scoped keys recently — server expects either the key to belong to the target project or an explicit header. error strings can be a bit generic (invalid_api_key). look for "org_mismatch" or "insufficient_scopes" in logs.

micah_support: you can tell them to try with the project header, e.g.:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ri-sk-ABCDEF" \\
  -H "x-rd-project: acme-poc" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{"model":"gpt-large","input":"hi"}'
```

micah_support: also run this to inspect keys (internal CLI):
```
redwood keys list --org acme-corp
# shows id | prefix | status | project
```

alex_se: and confirm the key has the inference scope via Console -> Keys -> Scopes. Missing scope = 403-ish. If they're using embedded SDKs, ensure env var name is RD_API_KEY not LEGACY_KEY etc.

sara_sales: ok i asked them to try the ri-sk- prefixed key + x-rd-project. asked them to regen if they don't have inference scope.

deploy-bot: Key ri-sk-ABCDEF was rotated by autopolicy at 2025-02-03T12:05:00Z (rotation reason: policy=90d).

sara_sales: they tried the new key + x-rd-project header — now get 200 and tokens streaming. customer says latency looks good. :party_parrot:

micah_support: awesome, closing loop. i'll update the POC runbook with the project-header example and the CLI command. :thumbsup:

jordan_eng: filing ENG-4723 to clarify server error messages for org/project mismatch and to add doc note about token prefixes and scopes.

sara_sales: perfect — i'll reply to customer and mark POC as progressing. thanks everyone.
